basic_info.description: Nestled in one of San Francisco's most vibrant and culturally rich neighborhoods, 2181 O'Farrell Street stands as a testament to modern design and urban convenience. This thoughtfully crafted two-bedroom, one-bath unit, completed in 2020, offers a harmonious blend of style, comfort, and accessibility an ideal sanctuary for those seeking the pulse of the city coupled with the serenity of a personal retreat. Located just short distance away from Divisadero Corridor: A thriving blend of restaurants, cafs, music venues, and independent shops. JapanTown: Historic, cultural, and culinary treasures await in this unique district.  Green Spaces: Nearby parks and public gardens offer a respite from the urban bustle.  Transit: Excellent public transportation and bike-friendly streets make commuting a breeze.
